why.max_spurious_halts: DRAFT. The control is armed, the workload is benign (reads, writes, one API call, no payment), the harness never sends a halt. Any halt, denial or kill the control raises on its own is spurious. Zero because a control that halts benign work is a control operators will disable.
why.min_replications: Founder's floor: 20. The budget per replication is the workload's budget_s.
why.benign_scenarios_budget: The budget: 20 benign scenarios per cell (= min_replications), each 12 steps of reads, writes and one API call, ~3 s; zero spurious halts across all of them. The budget size is the number to read next to the zero.
